title: Ensanguine
summary: ENSAN'GUINE, verb transitive [Latin sanguis, blood; Eng. sanguine.] To stain or cover with blood; to smear with gore; as an ensanguined field.

inlines.v: ENSAN'GUINE, verb transitive [Latin sanguis, blood; Eng. sanguine.] To stain or cover with blood; to smear with gore; as an ensanguined field.
